claims.locator: Section 4.1, PDF pages 16-17; Theorem 6.1, PDF page 33
claims.scope: Model and theorem statement checked; full proof not independently audited; not a claim of this packet.

claims.claim: Finite simulation limitations and improved heuristics
claims.scope: No simulation or author code rerun.

claims.claim: Disconnection iff exactly two complementary inheritance vectors occur
claims.scope: B >= 1; nonempty finite families; distinct parental symbols at each block.

claims.claim: Exact component-estimator recovery probability is product_i (1-(2^(m_i-1)-1)*2^(-B*(m_i-1)))
claims.scope: Independent fair bits for all children and blocks; fixed disjoint parental pairs; labeled sampled children.

claims.claim: Labeled family partition is identifiable from the distribution of the observed sharing graph for every B >= 1
claims.scope: Pair-sharing probabilities separate distinct partitions; no individual-parent naming or estimator-optimality conclusion.

claims.claim: Adding observed blocks merges components only within true families
claims.scope: Exact observations and disjoint parental symbols; no independence needed.

claims.claim: Correct one-block marginals with perfectly dependent blocks do not yield the independent-block recovery rate
claims.scope: One fair bit per child reused in every block; per-family success remains 2^(1-m).

claims.claim: A coupling with probability at most epsilon of differing observed graphs loses at most epsilon in recovery probability
claims.scope: The coupling and error bound are explicit additional assumptions, not inferred from biology or the ARG law.

new_derivation_attribution: Independent elementary derivations in this packet, motivated by the handoff model; no novelty claim and no attribution of these formulas to the paper.
